audit_items.proof_trace: TOKEN_EXPIRY.AUTHORIZATION_CODE is a module-level constant equal to 60*10=600 seconds; getAuthCodeExpiry() (oauth.ts:144-146) computes exactly Date.now()+600s and is the sole caller of create_authorization_code (actions.ts:103). The token endpoint unconditionally checks new Date(authCode.expires_at) < new Date() before issuing any access token (token/route.ts:100-106), rejecting expired codes with invalid_grant.
